definitions.explanation: A word or set of words by which a person, place, or thing is known. More literary than {名前|なまえ}.
One's standing or repute among others. Often used in expressions about fame or honor.

examples.japanese: {名|な}を{呼|よ}ばれて{返事|へんじ}をした。
examples.english: I responded when my name was called.

examples.japanese: {彼|かれ}は{世界|せかい}に{名|な}を{知|し}られている。
examples.english: He is known throughout the world.
examples.notes: 名を知られる = to be famous

examples.japanese: {名|な}もない{花|はな}が{咲|さ}いている。

notes:
USAGE: {名|な} is more literary and formal than {名前|なまえ}. It's commonly used in set expressions and idioms about names and reputation.

COMMON EXPRESSIONS:
・{名|な}を{挙|あ}げる (to make a name for oneself)
・{名|な}を{知|し}られる (to be known, famous)
・{名|な}を{残|のこ}す (to leave one's mark)
・{名|な}もない (nameless, unknown)
・{名|な}ばかり (in name only)
・{名|な}を{借|か}りる (to borrow someone's name)

COMPOUNDS:
・{名前|なまえ} (name - common word)
・{氏名|しめい} (full name - formal)
・{名字|みょうじ}/{苗字|みょうじ} (surname)
・{名刺|めいし} (business card)
・{名詞|めいし} (noun - grammar)
・{有名|ゆうめい} (famous)
・{無名|むめい} (unknown)

CONTRAST:
・{名|な} - literary, used in expressions
・{名前|なまえ} - everyday word for 'name'
